answer.answer: The us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets concept maps to the capex metric with PARTIAL fidelity — it includes software and other intangible assets that the core property-and-equipment concept does not. Because of this scope difference, the series does not continue across the change: the mapping records series_continues: false and a CONCEPT_MAPPING_BREAK from 2007-09-29 through 2014-09-27. Figures from this concept cannot be read as one continuous comparable series with the metric's other concepts (which use us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, mapped EXACT from 2013-09-28 onward).
